title: Whether this machine's assistants have the clawdline skill
description: GET /v1/skill reads, and POST /v1/skill/install installs, the stub `clawdline skill install` writes: one per assistant, under ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills. Both are this machine's own token only (403 `forbidden` otherwise), because the files are the person's own assistant configuration (design-guidelines DG-10): the console offers the install, and only a press makes it. The install writes only a target whose state is `missing` or `stale`; a `changed` or `other` file is somebody's, and is left for `clawdline skill install` to refuse or record by hand.

SkillReply.description: Every target, Claude Code's first. After an install, `state` is read again, so it says what is there now.

assistant.description: Which assistant reads this file: Claude Code reads ~/.claude/skills, Codex reads ~/.agents/skills.

path.description: The SKILL.md path on this machine.

state.description: `current` is this build's stub; `missing` is nothing there; `stale` is an earlier stub of ours; `changed` is our install edited since; `other` is a file or link that was never ours; `unreadable` is a state that could not be read, which never authorises a write.

outcome.description: POST only: what the install did here. `skipped` is a target that was current, or not ours to replace; `failed` is a write that did not complete.
